name: Brooks Molds
old_description: Welcome to Brooks Molds. We specialize in the tooling and manufacturing of molds for the cast polymer industry, including cultured marble, Tyvarian and solid surface molds. For over 20 years, we’ve been making molds that are unmatched in performance and unrivaled in craftsmanship, skillfully built with our hands just as much as with our hearts and our minds.  Our cast polymer fiberglass molds are built with quality materials and durable bracing systems, and we made our name producing durable standard and custom molds with industry-leading design and construction. We exceptionally specialize in customizing solutions for your unique mold needs. We will exceed your expectations, and you can count on peace of mind, productivity and innovation when you use our molds.
about:
Brooks Molds operates from Elmore, Alabama, where it has been a family-owned and operated business since 1999. The company traces its roots to 1984, when Bobby Brooks joined the mold and prototype department at Mortar Creek Plastics in Elmore. He advanced to shop supervisor and master pattern maker before launching Brooks Molds in 1999. His son Timothy now works alongside him, continuing the family operation.

The shop specializes in tooling and manufacturing molds for the cast polymer industry, serving producers of cultured marble, Tyvarian, and solid surface materials. Every mold is built by hand layup using fiberglass and composite resins, with each step monitored by the owners. The product line includes standard and custom bowls, wall panels, vanity tops, shower pans, shower niches, trim molds, and a range of custom patterns. The company maintains a master inventory of patterns and can handle both standard and custom design-and-build projects.

Customers are primarily cast polymer manufacturers and fabricators across the United States. Testimonials reference companies such as Majestic Kitchen & Bath, Micalline LLC, Amarillo Marble, Elite Marble, The Bath Collection, Carstin Brands, Easton Industries, Custom Bath Products, St. Louis Marble Company, Custom Designer Surface, Hall Marble, and BSWB Inc. These clients use Brooks molds in daily production of countertops, bath fixtures, and wall panels.

The company emphasizes durability and long service life, citing heavy-duty bracing systems, immaculate care of master patterns, and the use of what it describes as the industry's most effective materials. The goal is to reduce downtime from mold repairs and to deliver molds that stay in peak condition for years. Owners Bobby and Timothy Brooks oversee every build, a practice they say ensures consistent quality and custom solutions for unique mold needs.
